AMERICAN-RESOURCES, SOLVAY and REALLOYS each failed on the same defect class the 2026-09-14 munitions-replenishment placement audits already found on this mapping's author: a recorded source_excerpt that reads as one unbroken quotation is actually two sentences from non-adjacent parts of the cited page (1,014 characters apart on AMERICAN-RESOURCES; two full paragraphs apart on SOLVAY, which also silently drops the word 'The' at the seam; two paragraphs apart and out of the source's own sequence on REALLOYS, whose recorded excerpt places a later-appearing CSIS sentence before an earlier-appearing Euclid, Ohio sentence), joined with a bare space with no ellipsis or span-list marking. Every underlying claim is genuine and each half-sentence is independently verbatim; this is a citation-construction defect in the author's evidence recording, not a fabrication, and each FAIL entry's own source_excerpt reproduces the clean, single, genuinely contiguous half that by itself already supports the role.
